Post 1

📉 ASX 200 hit a 20-day low Wednesday, shedding 88.30pts or 0.97% to 8,978.40. Tech and materials got hammered. The index is now 3.42% off its 52-week high. The selling is broadening. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 IT off 3.35%, Materials down 3.08% — the two hardest-hit sectors dragged the whole market lower. Financials (+0.25%) and Consumer Staples (+0.81%) were the only real shelters. Classic risk-off rotation. #ASX #ausbiz #banking

Post 3

⛏️ Copper names bore the brunt. Capstone Copper fell 8.89% to AUD14.96, Firefly Metals dropped 7.69% to AUD1.74. Copper weakness offshore is hitting ASX-listed miners hard. #mining #copper #ASX

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD6,121.71/oz. Silver at AUD90.50/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.7145, metals priced in AUD remain elevated — cushioning miners in local terms even as global sentiment sours. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

ASX down 1.64% over five days and testing 8,978. Can buyers defend the 9,000 level? Watch US tech overnight — if it stabilises, IT and materials may find a floor. Where do you see support? #ASX #ausbiz #trading
